# UX / 交互需求质量 Checklist: 屏幕录制器 (Screen Recorder)

**Purpose**: 验证托盘交互、模式选择、区域框选、设置窗口与状态反馈等交互需求是否完整、清晰、一致且可验收
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the tray menu entries defined for every application state (idle, recording, exiting)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the default selected capture mode in the mode-selection dialog specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the visibility rules for the region editor versus the window list defined per selected mode? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the behavior of the "开始" button specified when the target is invalid (no region drawn, no window selected)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are keyboard interactions for the region selection overlay documented (cancel, confirm, minimum size)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the user feedback after a successful stop/save (notification, toast, reveal in folder) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the exit-while-recording flow (confirmation, save-or-discard) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the single-instance launch behavior (focus existing instance, refuse second session) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the window-list refresh behavior and the empty-list fallback specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are all user-visible texts/labels required to use one language (zh-CN) documented as a requirement? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 - Is "默认最小化到系统托盘" quantified as hiding both the front window and the taskbar entry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the presentation form of the three capture modes (radio list, cards, native menu) unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the modality/position/size of the settings window specified or explicitly delegated? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "录制期间托盘菜单可用、不阻塞" given observable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the coordinate unit (DIP) and origin (primary display top-left) for region inputs stated in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 - Do the tray menu requirements agree between §FR-003 (idle) and §FR-009 (recording)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do the region-editing requirements align between the mode dialog (§FR-006) and settings (§FR-007)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are "取消" semantics consistent across region framing, mode dialog, and exit-confirm flows? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK019 - Do the edge-case statements for the multi-monitor overlay match §FR-005? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 - Does every user story (US1–US4) have Given/When/Then scenarios a reviewer can execute? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec US1–US4]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is SC-001 ("≤10 秒发起录制") measurable with defined start (menu click) and end (recording starts) points? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is SC-006's usability metric (5 users, ≥4 succeed) tied to a defined test protocol? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are interaction flows specified for switching mode after entering a region or selecting a window? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the behavior defined when the window list is empty or the target window disappears before start? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements present for the settings window being opened while a recording is active? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are focus/foreground behaviors for the mode dialog and overlay specified (modal to tray, always-on-top, taskbar visibility)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional & Accessibility

- [ ] CHK027 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, high contrast, per-monitor DPI) defined for the tray UI and dialogs? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are interaction latency expectations for opening the mode dialog quantified? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the dependency on Windows system notifications documented, including behavior when notifications are disabled? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the assumption that the app's own overlay/dialog is never recorded (closed before capture starts) stated and validated? [Assumption, Spec Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
